serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Druva is a leading provider of data security and cyber resilience solutions, delivering a true cloud-native, fully managed SaaS platform for secure, air-gapped, zero trust, and immutable data protection across cloud, on-premises, and edge environments. Leveraging AWS GovCloud, Druva’s FedRAMP-authorized solution provides secure backup and disaster recovery while meeting strict U.S. government compliance standards. By centralizing data protection in a single platform, Druva strengthens incident response, cyber remediation, ransomware recovery and governance to help organizations reduce risk, cut costs, and simplify operations.
